response: Routine dissection of the station 9 lymph nodes may not be necessary for primary lung cancer. The metastasis rate of station 9 lymph nodes is significantly lower than other mediastinal stations, and the metastasis status of station 9 has no significant influence on tumor staging or prognosis. This suggests that routine dissection of these lymph nodes can be omitted, especially in patients with a low T stage, upper or middle lobe tumors, or without intrapulmonary lymph node metastasis.
